definitions.gloss: person who gets lonely easily; someone who doesn't like being alone
definitions.explanation: a person who frequently feels lonely and seeks company or attention from others

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{寂|さび}しがり{屋|や}だ。
examples.english: He is someone who gets lonely easily.

examples.japanese: {寂|さび}しがり{屋|や}なので、{一人|ひとり}でいるのが{苦手|にがて}だ。
examples.english: I get lonely easily, so I don't like being alone.

examples.japanese: うちの{犬|いぬ}は{寂|さび}しがり{屋|や}で、{留守番|るすばん}が{苦手|にがて}だ。
examples.english: Our dog gets lonely easily and doesn't do well when left alone.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
- {寂|さび}しい (lonely) + がる (to show signs of) + {屋|や} (person who tends to be)

ALTERNATIVE READING:
Also written as {淋|さび}しがり{屋|や}.

PERSONALITY SUFFIX -{屋|や}:
This suffix creates personality types:
- {恥|は}ずかしがり{屋|や} (shy person)
- {怖|こわ}がり{屋|や} (scaredy-cat)
- {頑張|がんば}り{屋|や} (hard worker)

NOTE:
Can also be used affectionately for pets that dislike being alone.
